verified_facts.text: The hotel is on Avenida Atlântica, close to Copacabana beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: from Copacabana beach, hemmed by stunning mosaic walkways, on Avenida Atlântica.

verified_facts.text: The hotel was modeled by French architect and designer Joseph Gire after the great beach hotels of the 19th and early 20th century.
verified_facts.excerpt: modeled by French architect and designer Joseph Gire after the great beach hotels of the 19th and early 20th century

verified_facts.text: Architect Joseph Gire built the hotel in the image of the great Riviera seaside hotels, in particular the Carlton in Cannes.
verified_facts.excerpt: French architect Joseph Gire built it in the image of the great Riviera seaside hotels, in particular the Carlton in Cannes

verified_facts.text: The 1933 film Flying Down to Rio used meticulously recreated sets that mimicked the hotel's facade.
verified_facts.excerpt: meticulously recreated sets mimicked our façade

verified_facts.text: Three restaurants are grouped around the pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: around which three restaurants are grouped, creating a chilled hangout to rival the nearby beach

verified_facts.text: The restaurants are Cipriani (Italian), MEE (Asian fusion) and Pérgula (Brazilian classics).
verified_facts.excerpt: Asian fusion at MEE and Brazilian classics at Pérgula

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a rooftop tennis court.
verified_facts.excerpt: a surprise glimpse of the rooftop tennis court and the spa is hidden away behind oil paintings

verified_facts.text: The spa is in the new annex and offers a grapeseed-oil Harmonia massage.
verified_facts.excerpt: visit the spa in the new annex for a balancing grapeseed-oil Harmonia massage

verified_facts.text: The concierge desk sorts tickets in advance for the trip up to the Christ the Redeemer statue on Corcovado.
verified_facts.excerpt: The concierge desk will make inherently stressful endeavors such as heading up to the Christ the Redeemer statue on Corcovado more manageable by sorting tickets in advance

verified_facts.text: The hotel runs entirely on renewable energy.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel runs entirely on renewable energy

verified_facts.text: There are a number of accessible rooms, and the restaurants are all accessible via ramp.
verified_facts.excerpt: There are a number of accessible rooms and the restaurants are all accessible via ramp.

verified_facts.text: Beach service includes cold face towels and a watering can to cool down burning feet.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beach service includes not only cold face towels but, incredibly, a watering can to cool down burning feet.

verified_facts.text: The Botanical Garden, the Sugarloaf Mountain cable car and the bossa nova bars and restaurants of Ipanema are easily reached by taxi.
verified_facts.excerpt: First-timer pit-stops such as the Botanical Garden and Sugarloaf Mountain cable car, as well as the bossa nova bars and restaurants of Ipanema, are easily reached by taxi.

verified_facts.text: Belmond, then the Orient-Express group, took over the hotel in 1989.
verified_facts.excerpt: Belmond (then the Orient-Express group) took over in 1989

verified_facts.text: Rooms have a sitting area of living-room proportions, a sofa and a huge desk.
verified_facts.excerpt: with a sitting area of proper living-room proportions, a sofa and a huge desk

verified_facts.text: Orson Welles stayed at the hotel for eight months in 1942.
verified_facts.excerpt: host wunderkind Orson Welles at our hotel for eight months in 1942
